severe_examples.word:vision: Current still retains a supernatural apparition branch and rare verb as ordinary Active competition; learner value should center eyesight and strategic/future vision.
severe_examples.word:vocal: Current lacks the common outspoken/strongly-expressing-opinions adjective and keeps a musical noun as ordinary Active.
severe_examples.word:voluntary: Specialist musical noun remains learner-active instead of lower/domain-marked material.
severe_examples.word:vulgar: Historical common-people/vernacular sense remains ordinary Active rather than marked historical/register-lower.
severe_examples.word:wait: Rare/dated serve-tables verb remains Active and competes with ordinary waiting.
severe_examples.word:watt: Proper-name James Watt remains an ordinary learner sense even though the lexical item should be the electrical-power unit.
severe_examples.word:weak: Technical grammatical weak-verb material remains ordinary Active.
severe_examples.word:web: Current lacks explicit modern World Wide Web / online-network learner access.
severe_examples.word:weird: Archaic fate/destiny noun remains Active alongside the modern strange/uncanny adjective.
severe_examples.word:what: Current still fragments a function-word network by POS/context instead of a controlled interrogative/relative/exclamative model.
severe_examples.word:which: Current splits selection function into pronoun/adjective rows; latest learner target should avoid POS-only semantic inflation.
severe_examples.word:whereas: Legal recital `whereas = considering that` remains ordinary Active instead of domain/register-lower.
severe_examples.word:whether: Archaic pronoun-like `which of two` material remains Active.
severe_examples.word:white: Human racial/social use is presented as a broad unrestricted taxonomy rather than context-sensitive, neutral identity wording.
severe_examples.word:widow: Current still defines widow through husband only instead of a woman whose spouse has died.
severe_examples.word:will: Modal `will` is reduced to a simple future marker and does not own intention/willingness or characteristic tendency.
severe_examples.word:window: Current lacks the high-value time/opportunity window branch and retains a rare furnishing-with-windows verb.
severe_examples.word:with: Current is still split into multiple prepositional micro-senses; target is one broad relation marker with contextual realizations.
severe_examples.word:witness: Religious witness material and an awkward time/setting branch remain ordinary Active competition.
severe_examples.word:word: Computing word remains ordinary Active while the high-value promise/message phraseology needs structural ownership.
severe_examples.word:worm: Insult, screw-thread and low-value verb material remain Active and overcompete with animal/computer-worm branches.
severe_examples.word:would: Current lacks the modal network for conditionality, polite requests/offers, repeated past habit, preference and polite desire.
severe_examples.word:zip: Current overpromotes slang zero/energy and does not cleanly center zipper/fasten, archive/compress, move quickly and ZIP recognition.
severe_examples.word:bosom: Chest/breast and inner-feelings uses lack the required old-fashioned/literary/figurative register control.
severe_examples.word:Englishman: Current correctly means a man from England but lacks neutral English person guidance where gender is irrelevant.
severe_examples.word:Fahrenheit: Current treats Fahrenheit too narrowly as adjectival instead of a temperature-scale name with noun/adjectival use.
severe_examples.word:haircut: Current lacks the common finance haircut = reduction in asset value branch.
severe_examples.word:intern: Meaning branches exist, but noun-trainee versus verb-detain stress identity is not first-class.
severe_examples.word:Pacific: Proper Pacific and lowercase pacific are silently merged under one capitalized owner rather than case-sensitive identities.
severe_examples.word:railroad: Current lacks the common figurative verb force/rush through a process unfairly.
severe_examples.word:seaman: Gender-specific identity lacks neutral sailor/seafarer guidance.

fresh_semantic_judgments.latest: Current already owns occupation/career plus calling/strong-suitability without malformed prepositional clutter.
Current cleanly owns human voice, right/opportunity to express an opinion, and verb voice = express concerns/opinions.
Current empty-space, empty, cancel/nullify and legally-invalid branches are learner-usable and do not expose specialist excretion as an ordinary competing sense.
Current already separates physical capacity, loudness, book volume and quantity without low-value cruft.
Current method, route, aspect and degree/distance model is compact and learner-usable; additional high-value expressions remain Expansion work.
Current satisfactory manner, good health, water well, well up and functional interjection are genuine polysemy/functions rather than dictionary micro-sense clutter.
Current noun period, temporal conjunction and contrast conjunction already match the productive learner branches; while away remains separate Expansion.
Current owns both semantic branches for each word; the fixed surfaces brood over and brook no ... remain separate Expansion debt.
Current already includes the intended modern semantic branches for these words without the historical low-value clutter; missing fixed phrases remain Expansion-level only.
Current distinguishes duty/advice from expectation/probability; the main remaining debt is modal-auxiliary structural presentation (`ought to`, `ought to have`) rather than Core meaning.
Keep the ordinary learner identity plural `outskirts`; singular `outskirt` is uncommon recognition. Current meaning is right but needs first-class form/construction ownership.
Do not split learner semantics solely by pronoun/adjective or prepositional context. Model a selection-function network for which and a broad relation-marker network for with.
Use context-sensitive neutral race/social wording for white and define widow through spouse rather than husband-only wording.

Treat modal/function networks structurally: will = prediction/intention/tendency; would = past-future/conditional/polite/habit/preference/desire; wish = desire plus counterfactual/regret constructions.
Keep accurate sex/gender-specific lexical identity while removing partner-role conflation and supplying neutral alternatives when gender is irrelevant.
Own noun trainee with initial stress versus verb detain/confine with final stress as first-class Word/Form identity; medical intern is a domain application of trainee.
Separate proper Pacific ocean/region from lowercase pacific = peaceful/peace-making as case-sensitive identities rather than merging them under one headword presentation.
Own Fahrenheit as a scale name with noun/adjectival use and the ordinary degrees Fahrenheit / Fahrenheit scale patterns.
Add the common figurative verb meaning force or rush someone/something through a process without fair choice or deliberation, alongside AmE railway noun.
